options.title: FX FREEZE
options.summary: The FX 2-way switch as freeze, chosen on config row 3 step 16: LONG freezes. Loops the delay; holds the reverb tail with FX REVERB.

controls.does: TURNS THE FX SWITCH INTO FREEZE, OR BACK
WHEN TURNED ON (CONFIG ROW 3 STEP 16): LONG FREEZES THE DELAY OR THE REVERB TAIL
